Extracted 2026-10-10 from the render-samples artifacts of jobs jf3tmylp and wwopccov (byte-identical artifacts — deterministic rendering). system_prompt:
You are a helpful AI assistant.
Knowledge cutoff: 2026-01-04.
Current date: {date}.

Reasoning strength: high.

# Valid recipients: "self", "user".
notes: The renderer injects this default system prompt with a dynamic date stamp. Training saw 2026-10-10. For eval comparability, pin the date (either 2026-10-10 to match training exactly, or one fixed eval date applied identically to both arms).
Assistant turns carry a recipient tag ('to=user'). Only that recipient value appears in the pilot corpus; unknown recipients are untested behavior.
Loss masking on the provider: non-assistant spans (BOS, system, user turns, turn headers) masked to 0; assistant content trained exactly once per row; per-datum weights normalized (sum 1.0).
Dataset rows are rendered per-user-turn (multi-turn rows unroll into multiple datums).

provenance.verification: Exactly one distinct system prompt and one assistant-header form across all 20 datums in each artifact; weights sum to 1.0 per datum; max datum 2065 tokens of 32768.
